combined_rule.current_seen_objects: diagnostic only for v0.2 because their coordinates/masses were inspected before this freeze.
combined_rule.promotion: No physical promotion from either test alone. Require direction and scale effects to survive stated controls and independent replication.

cosmology_anchor.compact_object_proxy: Schwarzschild mass proxy unless spin is independently available
cosmology_anchor.source_policy: Planck 2018 baseline fixed before catalog inspection

directional_estimator.construction: orient all published axes to northern Galactic hemisphere; normalize Euclidean sum of their unit vectors
directional_estimator.source: Planck 2013 Table 18 MAMD axes, four component-separation maps C-R/NILC/SEVEM/SMICA, uncorrected primary rows

population.catalog: van den Bosch 2016 ApJ 831, 134; VizieR J/ApJ/831/134/table2
population.direction_subset: top 10 percent by central BH mass among eligible held-out rows; K=ceil(0.10*N)
population.primary_rows: catalog rows used in the paper fit (selected=1 where available), finite positive BH mass and sky coordinates

primary_direction_test.null: permute BH mass labels across the fixed eligible sky coordinates; recompute top-decile subset and T_dir
primary_direction_test.purpose: controls survey/sky-footprint selection under exchangeability of masses and coordinates
primary_direction_test.statistic: T_dir = mean(abs(dot(n_i,a))) over top-decile mass subset

primary_scale_test.control: scan q in [1.5,3.0] only as diagnostic; q=2 remains the sole preregistered target and may not be moved
primary_scale_test.uncertainty: propagate catalog mass uncertainties by Monte Carlo when available; report proxy limitation from unknown Kerr spin
